verdict_text:
NO

The projection regex omits `attn.c_proj.weight`, so only 36 matrices (c_attn, c_fc, mlp.c_proj) are cast to bfloat16 and the 12 `h.<i>.attn.c_proj.weight` tensors stay float32, violating Required result 1 (exactly the 48 listed projection matrices must be bfloat16). The script also asserts the bfloat16 count is 36 instead of 48, violating the Required checks clause "exactly 48 tensors are bfloat16"; the check would pass on the wrong output rather than failing loudly.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
